description: This file defines a minimal safe wrapper around the browser's localStorage API, primarily used for client-side analytics with string keys and values. It includes functions for getting, setting, and removing items from localStorage, with error handling and checks for server environment.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item from localStorage safely, returning null if unavailable or in a server environment.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Sets an item in localStorage safely, silently ignoring errors or server environments.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from localStorage safely, ignoring errors and server environments.
